subject.title: feat: add flexible multi-sidebar chat layout

question: Should Control UI replace the existing shared sidebar-ratio preference with per-session multi-column layout persistence, and if so what upgrade behavior must preserve existing users’ sidebar widths?
rationale: This is a new prominent Control UI interaction model and persistence contract; code review can identify the lost preference but cannot choose whether to migrate it, intentionally reset it, or retain a compatibility mapping.

options.title: Preserve existing width on upgrade
options.body: Add a one-time conversion from the old stored ratio to the initial applicable sidebar-column width and prove fresh-install and upgraded layouts.

options.title: Approve an intentional layout reset
options.body: Accept that upgraded users receive the new defaults, but make the reset explicit in maintainer-visible product direction and user-facing release context.

options.title: Narrow the feature before landing
options.body: Keep the existing ratio model until the per-session persistence and drag/drop design has an approved upgrade contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing width on upgrade
recommendation.body: Add a one-time conversion from the old stored ratio to the initial applicable sidebar-column width and prove fresh-install and upgraded layouts.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch’s recent implementation history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the layout and persistence design decision.
